Container.Name: Buybutler
Container.Overview:
Remember which groceries to buy again and which not, with a reason, 1 to 5 stars, the store, the date, a photo and optionally the price paid. Scan the barcode with the phone camera; product names and pictures come from Open Food Facts. Every entry keeps the time it was made and last changed.
After the first start, create a user in the container's console: buybutler user add NAME.
The camera in the browser needs HTTPS: open it through a reverse proxy with a certificate. The appdata folder holds the database and all photos; back it up.

Config.Name: Web interface
Config.Description: Port of the web interface. Point the reverse proxy here.

Config.Name: Config
Config.Description: Database, pictures and backups. Never delete it.

Config.Name: UMASK
Config.Description: 002: new files are writable for the users group

Config.Name: TZ
Config.Description: Time zone: decides the date a rating gets by default, and the log

Config.Name: Product language
Config.Description: Language of product names from Open Food Facts (two letters)

Config.Name: Currency
Config.Description: Currency of all prices, a three-letter code such as EUR or CHF

Config.Name: Open Food Facts lookup
Config.Description: false: never send barcodes to Open Food Facts; products are entered by hand

Config.Name: Session days
Config.Description: Days a login stays valid without being used

Config.Name: Trusted proxies
Config.Description: Addresses whose X-Forwarded headers are trusted; the reverse proxy's address, or *
